shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — cross-level combat verified with 1:1 shot side effects, one-map audio, cross-level tracers, and one-map AI targeting (CE support next), plus wide stairs, elevators, pod transit, opt-in threats, world integration, AUR guard, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB, dim slider. Things shrink about own center (belowThingScale).
- All levels are real maps: SURFACE is the world-tile map; SKY + BASEMENT are pocket maps (PocketMapParent) added via Current.Game.AddMap, so they live in Find.Maps and **tick every game tick in real time** regardless of which is viewed. Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap (LevelCamera + Game.CurrentMap setter lock).
- Basement environments are choosable. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat. Sky mountain naturalistic. Pod handoff LATE (22t).
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline. Cross-level work: strictly-better rank, main-thread only, real migration probe.
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**; FORCED-ORDER PARITY; NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY; SEAMLESS CONTINUATION; CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD; IsPlayerHome column identity (ColumnAsHome).
- **FOREIGN-MAP ELIGIBILITY GATE**: z-levels excluded from foreign special maps (AUR submaps). Fail-open.
- TEXTURE POLICY: user supplies stair art. PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP (docs/).

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B, through-the-gap ranged) — Source/Combat/ — VERIFIED run #89
Vanilla has no third dimension, so a projectile lives on one 2D map and vanilla refuses a cross-map cast. Robust workaround: spawn the projectile on the TARGET's map so flight/armour/impact/damage are 100% vanilla there. Only target acquisition (LoF + range across the gap) and the launch are custom. Direct verbs use sky-plane LoF; ARC verbs (mortars) lob over via open-air holes. Pawn shooters run JobDriver_ABCrossLevelAttack; turrets run a tick-accurate warmup->burst->cooldown driver (CrossLevelTurret). AI auto-engage (CrossLevelAutoEngage). All gated by ABGuard.Combat + crossLevelCombat, fail-open.

### VANILLA SHOT PARITY (ABShotEffects.cs) — 2026-07-23, self-test 14/14
Replays the full cast pipeline the hand-rolled launch bypassed. Per shot: soundCast + soundCastTail, ShotFlash muzzle fleck, pawn notifies (used verb / mindState engaged+attacked via cached Harmony open-delegates / MentalState / health / weapon), ShotsFired record, CompChangeableProjectile unload + CompApparelVerbOwner_Charged discharge, consumeFuelPerShot. On the projectile: CompUniqueWeapon damageDefOverride + extraDamages. Per burst: BattleLogEntry_RangedFire + Shooting XP (170x/20x, live non-mech pawn targets). Turrets get log but no XP. Swallow-safe.

### ONE-MAP AUDIO (ABCombatSoundContext.cs) — 2026-07-23, VERIFIED
FIX for "no combat sounds across levels": Verse.SoundDefHelper.CorrectContextNow hard-silences any in-map sound whose sourceMap != Find.CurrentMap (gate lives 3 layers down in SampleOneShotManager/Sample, NOT in PlayOneShot). Harmony prefix treats the current column's paired sky/surface level as the SAME audio context. Scoped to ONE-SHOTS ONLY (def.sustain==false) so all combat one-shots (shots/impacts/cracks/hits/pain/death) are audible across the gap while sustainers stay vanilla (no doubled ambience). Both directions. Gated on showLiveBelow + ABGuard.Rendering; fails open.

### CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (ABCrossLevelTracers.cs) — 2026-07-23, VERIFIED
FIX for "projectiles don't sync in location/speed": the real cross-gap projectile is only visible from above where the sky cell over it is open air, so a single-column hole hides it. Chosen approach = explicit tracer (option B): every DIRECT cross-level shot registers a short-lived bolt drawn spanning BOTH levels (shooter->target, below endpoint via ShiftedBelowDrawPos), animating head-first at bullet pace (dur = clamp(dist/55, .05-.28s), wall-clock realtime). GenDraw.DrawLineBetween at MetaOverlays altitude, solid-color mat. Physics/damage unchanged. Registered in CrossLevelCombat.Fire, drawn from LevelComp.MapComponentUpdate. Direct fire only.

### ONE-MAP AI TARGETING (CrossLevelAutoEngage.cs) — 2026-07-23, VERIFIED
FIX for "AI doesn't target across levels": (1) scan cadence 250->60 ticks for ~1s reaction. (2) Replaced the last-resort hostile gate with a ONE-MAP nearest-target comparison: NearestSameMapEnemyDistSq(p) vs the chosen cross-level target; TryEngageAcross takes maxDistSq and engages a cross-level target only when it is CLOSER (plumb-horizontal) than the nearest same-map enemy. So a hostile fights whoever is nearest across BOTH levels - shoots up/down the instant the paired-level target is nearest, even with farther same-map targets, but is never yanked off a closer same-map fight. Bounded (capped engages/probes + 700t per-pawn failure cooldown). Drafted overwatch + turret event hooks already react at vanilla cadence.

### COMBAT EXTENDED SUPPORT — PLANNED (Phase 2, next up)
CE (decompiled 1.6): Verb_LaunchProjectileCE : Verb (NOT Verb_LaunchProjectile), ProjectileCE : ThingWithComps (NOT Projectile). GetRangedVerb returns null for CE weapons -> cross-level ranged currently INERT with CE (no crash; walk stairs). Plan: reuse geometry/LoF, spawn ProjectileCE on target map via CE Launch(launcher,origin,shotAngle,shotRotation,shotHeight,shotSpeed,equipment,distance) - shotHeight = elevation lever for plunging fire. Decided: SIMPLER-CUT accuracy (our aim roll for hit/miss, CE ballistics+armour+suppression downstream); PARITY ammo (consume magazine via CompAmmoUser). Packaging: isolated compat assembly hard-ref CombatExtended.dll, LoadFolders `<li IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended">`, CE types in method bodies / object-typed signatures only. Tracers + one-map audio + one-map AI are verb-agnostic and already apply to CE shots once they route through Fire-equivalent.

## BUILDING ART — FINALIZED 2026-07-23
Directional art set (_north/_east/_south; east auto-mirrors west). NO uiIconPath on stair defs. Baked drawSize/offsets in AB_Stairs.xml.

## SEE-BELOW view (BelowSelection / LevelRenderer / BelowThingOverlays)
Plumb one-way mirror (sky level 1 draws surface below; parallax removed, altitude-drop only). Select in place; double-click select-all-of-type; below overlays. Filter: a lower thing draws only when the sky cell above it is open air + unroofed + unfogged + in view. Fail-open.

## BASEMENT ENVIRONMENTS (BasementEnv registry + gensteps) — 2026-07-23
Unified `basementType` setting (migration via basementMigrated). Types: SolidRock (default), Caverns (Biomes! Caverns), Foreign biome carve (4 curated Alpha Biomes: AB_MycoticJungle/GelatinousSuperorganism/RockyCrags/TarPits), UrbanRuins (Ancient urban ruins buried facility, portals stripped, occupants optional). REVEAL ON LOAD (basementRevealed, default ON): LevelComp.FinalizeInit clears all fog on basements.

## HAULING MOD COMPAT (Scope B) — PUAH + HD user-verified
ABInventoryHaulBridge -> CrossLevelHaulJob.Build -> JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels + WorkGiver. Allow Tool urgent crosses first.

## ANCIENT URBAN RUINS COMPAT — 2026-07-23
Host XMB.AncientUrbanrUins.MO. Reflection only, fail-open. Eligibility guard excludes z-levels from AUR submaps by default (allowLevelsOnUrbanRuins opt-in). Basement stamping: TryStampFacility + SpawnThingsNoPortals + StripPortals.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (run #62 and prior; basement rework #86; combat parity self-test #88 14/14; cross-level combat feel #89)
Priority work; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat (sounds + tracers + one-map AI VERIFIED); pod transit + AA; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant; modder API. PUAH/HD bulk + Allow Tool urgent good.

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs: Generation / View and camera / Work and logistics / Job scanning / Combat and threats / Compat / Advanced.

## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite (cross-gap combat, auto-engage, etc.); below-view diagnostic.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Alpha Biomes (soft, 4 basement biomes). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). Hauler's Dream + PUAH (bulk, user-verified). Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. **Combat Extended: cross-level ranged still INERT (Phase 2 next); parity/audio/tracer/one-map-AI layer is vanilla-only for now.** Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (soft). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-23: **Cross-level combat feel FIXED + VERIFIED (run #89, user "tests good")** - all four reported defects resolved: one-map audio (SoundDefHelper.CorrectContextNow prefix), cross-level tracers (option B), one-map AI targeting (nearest-across-both-levels + 60t cadence), real-time (both levels already tick live). On top of Phase 1 shot parity (ABShotEffects, self-test 14/14). Build green (0/0). **NEXT: Phase 2 - Combat Extended cross-level support** (ProjectileCE on target map via CE Launch w/ shotHeight; simpler-cut accuracy; PARITY ammo; isolated LoadFolders-gated compat assembly). Outstanding chores: translation audit, palette pin watch, mech escort test, settings preview pass, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
